nodes.title: SG-2.2 · Move game runtime from backend/game to top-level game/
nodes.body:
Context: the game runtime (src/engine, src/state, src/systems, src/content, content/worlds/the-boys-room, tests, vitest/tsconfig/package.json) currently lives in backend/game. The goal specifies a top-level game/ module separate from the Go backend. Desired behavior: the same files live under game/ with unchanged relative layout, the old backend/game folder is gone, and the tests still pass. Why: separation of runtime concerns from the Go backend.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo, when listing game/, then game/src/engine, game/src/state, game/src/systems, game/content and game/tests exist and backend/game does not
- Given game/, when running vitest there, then all existing tests pass with no changes to src logic
- Given .gitignore, when read, then it ignores game/node_modules/ and no longer references backend/game


## Scope
- In scope: git mv of backend/game to game
- In scope: fixing path references in config and ignore files
- Out of scope: changes to engine or system logic
- Out of scope: Go backend code
- Out of scope: frontend/worker modules
- Preserve: relative layout inside the module
- Preserve: existing test behavior
- Preserve: world.yaml and bedroom.yaml content


## Technical constraints
- Use git mv to retain history
- Relative imports in src and tests must keep working unchanged


## Definition of done
- game/ holds the full runtime
- backend/game removed
- tests pass from game/


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Runtime source, content and tests live under game/
nodes.body:
Context: backend/game contains package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts, src/{content,engine,state,systems}, content/worlds/the-boys-room and tests. Desired behavior: these files exist at game/ with the same relative paths and nothing remains in backend/game. Expected result: imports like ../src/content/loader and content paths like ../content/worlds/the-boys-room resolve unchanged. Why: top-level game module per the goal.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the move, when listing game/, then src/engine, src/state, src/systems, src/content, content/worlds/the-boys-room, tests, package.json, tsconfig.json and vitest.config.ts exist
- Given the move, when checking backend/, then backend/game does not exist
- Given game/content/worlds/the-boys-room, when loadWorld runs on it, then it loads without validation errors


## Scope
- In scope: moving all tracked files of backend/game
- Out of scope: editing file contents beyond path fixes
- Preserve: relative paths between src, tests and content


## Technical constraints
- git mv, not copy/delete


## Definition of done
- files moved
- old folder removed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Ignore and config paths point at game/ not backend/game
nodes.body:
Context: .gitignore line 10 is backend/game/node_modules/. vitest.config.ts includes tests/**/*.test.ts and tsconfig includes src and tests, both relative so valid after the move. Desired behavior: .gitignore ignores game/node_modules/ and no stale backend/game reference remains. Expected result: node_modules under game/ is never tracked. Why: avoid committing dependencies after relocation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given .gitignore, when read, then it contains the line game/node_modules/
- Given .gitignore, when read, then no line contains backend/game
- Given game/vitest.config.ts and game/tsconfig.json, when read, then they include tests and src relative globs


## Scope
- In scope: .gitignore path fix
- Out of scope: new ignore rules
- Preserve: all other .gitignore lines


## Technical constraints
- Change only the stale line


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- .gitignore updated


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Move backend/game to top-level game/
nodes.body:
Context: backend/game holds the full TypeScript runtime. Desired behavior: move it wholesale so relative imports stay valid. Expected result: game/ contains every former file and backend/game is gone. Why: top-level module layout.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo root, when running git mv backend/game game, then game/src and game/content exist
- Given the move, when checking backend/game, then it is absent


## Scope
- In scope: move of all files
- Out of scope: logic changes
- Preserve: file contents


## Technical constraints
- git mv from repo root
- Code path: `backend/game/package.json`
- Code path: `backend/game/package-lock.json`
- Code path: `backend/game/tsconfig.json`
- Code path: `backend/game/vitest.config.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/content/loader.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/engine/scene.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/state/types.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/state/gameState.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/state/persistence.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/systems/inventory.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/systems/dialogue.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/systems/conditions.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/src/systems/events.ts`
- Code path: `backend/game/content/worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml`
- Code path: `backend/game/content/worlds/the-boys-room/scenes/bedroom.yaml`


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- backend/game removed
- game/ populated
